verdict.rationale: Tavily's own Research endpoint lets users hand off a research task to a built-in agentic process. It runs multiple searches, analyzes sources and produces a report, with mini/pro modes, async task retrieval and streaming. However, this is an API capability scoped to research, not a general in-product AI assistant. Other agent mentions (coding-agent setup, MCP for external clients, the Mintlify-hosted docs MCP) are external agents or the host platform and earn no credit. missing for 10: an in-product assistant (e.g., dashboard/playground copilot), delegation of general tasks beyond web research, independent or hands-on corroboration of assistant-style delegation.
